note: Language-neutral micro-tests. Expected values are derived by hand from the reference text, not from either implementation. Maps are official .map text, ants are official .ant text (one per colony), world wraps unless wrap=false. checks[].ants lists only the fields to compare: id, alive, x, y, dir, pc, food, rest; cells: x, y, food, marks (one bitmask per colony); draws = RNG draws so far.

cases.name: pace: a mover acts every 15 rounds
cases.spec: Ant tab: resting = 14 after a successful move; Semantics: resting>0 decrements and skips

cases.name: move failure: blocked by rock keeps the ant, no rest, takes the else branch
cases.spec: Semantics: Move fails if the target is obstructed; next = else; resting unchanged

cases.name: wrap and row parity: north-east across the top edge of a 4x4 torus
cases.spec: World tab: dir 5 is (x,y-1) on even rows and (x+1,y-1) on odd rows; coordinates wrap

cases.name: wrap west across the left edge
cases.spec: World tab: x' = (x' + max_x) mod max_x
ants:
Turn Left 1
Turn Left 2
Turn Left 3
Move 3 3

cases.name: self-sensing: an ant carrying food matches FriendWithFood on its own cell
cases.spec: Ant tab: friendwithfood -> friend && has_food > 0; Here is the current cell
ants:
Move 1 0
PickUp 2 1
Sense Here 3 4 FriendWithFood
Mark 0 5
Mark 1 5
Drop 5

cases.name: surround: five enemy neighbours kill an ant; it leaves 3 food
cases.spec: Combat tab: >= 5 enemy neighbours kill; dead ant value 3 + carried; checked after a successful move

cases.name: surround boundary: four enemy neighbours do not kill (Classic has no scare rule)
cases.spec: Combat tab: kill threshold 5; the 4-enemy case is a deferred flag, off in Classic

cases.name: flip consumes one draw: seed 12345 first draw 7193 mod 3 = 2, so the else branch
cases.spec: RNG tab: randomint(n) = x_i mod n, i increments per call; flipzero r = 0 -> next, else jump

cases.name: flip with p = 1 always takes the zero branch and still consumes a draw
cases.spec: RNG tab: randomint(1) = 0

cases.name: marks: mark and unmark set and clear single bits of the own colony byte
cases.spec: Ant tab: 6 markers per colony; Mark i sets, Unmark i clears bit i, other bits and colonies untouched

cases.name: marks: Marker reads the own bit only; FoeMarker sees any bit of the other colony
cases.spec: Ant tab: marker m = own colony marker m; foemarker = any enemy marker present; a colony never sees its own marks as foe marks
ants:
Mark 2 1
Sense Here 3 2 FoeMarker
Sense Here 4 3 Marker 2
Drop 3
Drop 4

Turn Left 1
Turn Left 2
Turn Left 3
Sense Ahead 4 7 FoeMarker
Sense Ahead 6 5 Marker 2
Drop 5
Drop 6
Drop 7

cases.name: pickup and drop: capacity one, a second pickup fails, drop puts the packet back
cases.spec: Semantics tab: PickUp fails when has_food >= CAP (1 in Classic) or the cell has no food; Drop adds has_food to the cell
ants:
Move 1 0
PickUp 2 1
PickUp 4 3
Drop 5
Drop 4
PickUp 6 7
Turn Left 6
Drop 7

cases.name: pickup on a cell without food takes the else branch
cases.spec: Semantics tab: PickUp fails when food_at(pos) == 0

cases.name: sensing on an odd row: LeftAhead is direction-1 (north-east), found by the first test only
cases.spec: Ant tab: leftahead = adjacent(pos, turn_left(dir)); odd row, dir 5 -> (x+1, y-1)

cases.name: home and foehome: own nest vs the other colony nest, here and ahead
cases.spec: Ant tab: home = base_at(pos, colony); foehome = a nest of another colony

cases.name: move failure: blocked by an ant; ids act in ascending order
cases.spec: Semantics tab: Move fails when the target is obstructed or occupied; id 0 acts before id 1, so it is still blocked

cases.name: surround order: the mover is checked first, then directions 0..5, and a kill lowers later counts
cases.spec: Combat tab: check_for_surrounded_ants = destination, then dir 0..5 sequentially. The ants at (6,5) and (6,6) each have 5 enemies after the move; (6,5) is checked first and dies, which leaves (6,6) with 4
